correctness.rationale: For reflection w_i=w_{c-i}, a k-window at i reflects to reversed window at C-i, C=c-k+1. Each of q^ceil(k/2) palindrome factors occurs once in every residue mod n, forcing every fixed residue of r->C-r to lift uniquely to a distinct fixed start mod L=n q^k. Thus q^ceil(k/2)f_n(C)<=f_L(C)<=2. Odd n gives f_n=1 and necessity q=2,k<=2; repetition (01)^n and (0011)^n is perfect for odd n by gcd(n,2)=gcd(n,4)=1 and palindromic up to rotation. Even n and C even would give f_n=2 with L even and an impossible >=4 fixed starts, so C odd. For odd n nonexceptions, reversal acts freely and bracelet count equals half of existing necklace count. The even example is a necessary-condition witness, not full sufficiency.
